description: Ask TransparentCars to source & quote a specific car to import (from German/EU auctions). Only call when the user wants an import quote, provides the wanted model plus their own name and a phone or email, AND agrees to be contacted — pass consent=true only then. Never invent, guess, or use placeholder / example / test contact details: pass ONLY the real name and real phone or e-mail the user gave you in this conversation. If you don't have a real phone or e-mail from the user, ask them for it before calling — do not submit fake values. Submitting shares the provided contact details per the TransparentCars privacy policy.

consent.description: Set true ONLY if the user explicitly agreed to share their contact details and be contacted

contact.description: A phone number or email where they can be reached

name: request_import_quote
